featured_reviews.name: NOSHIR KATRAK
featured_reviews.review_text:
Warden Bakery situated at August Kranti Maiden. Just next to Camy Wafer shop.
The name bakery itself is a self explanatory name where you can avail various biscuits, breads, pastries.
You can really enjoy the fresh baked breads, you name it and all sort of breads are available - Pizza, Dabeli, Garlic, Sweet, Regular breads to name a few.
Their pastries are exclusive, you will not find them at any other place.
The Almond tart, Butterscotch tart, Coconut biscuits, cream rolls, just fantastic, one cannot stop eating.
You can even purchase Mayoniese, Ketchups, different sauces required for preparing Pizzas and other tantalizing dishes.
Chocolate, Strawberry pastries - Oh My God!
Quick service and staff informs the customer to maintain safe distance.
It is open till 8.30 p.m.
Don't miss an opportunity to enjoy their mouth watering tarts, if one is present in the nearby area.

featured_reviews.review_text:

I wanted to push further and ask if they were lactose free too (but I wasnt trying to be a ..pain). The Dutch Truffle Deluxe was all it was described to be. The little cafe, was a delight. Can't wait to try the cold craft beer and cold sandwich in the midday heat next!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing experience!
I ordered a bouquet of chocolates from Birdy's after seeing it clearly listed on their Zomato page. I waited patiently for almost 50 minutes, only to receive a call later saying the product isn’t available. This is absolutely unacceptable.

If you don’t have a product, don’t mislead customers by showing it online. This shows poor management, lack of coordination, and zero respect for customers’ time. I was genuinely looking forward to trying Birdy's, but after this experience, I have no intention of ever ordering or visiting again.

Such a pathetic level of service completely ruins trust. Please fix your listings and your attitude toward customers.
